title: Community Bank, BREB sign agreement for Rural Electricity Bill collection
snippet: Recent research from Citigroup and others has also concluded that quantum computing, along with artificial intelligence breakthroughs, has compressed the time
extractedText: Community Bank Bangladesh PLC has signed an agreement with the Bangladesh Rural Electrification Board (BREB), allowing customers of all Palli Bidyut Samities under BREB to pay their electricity bills through Community Bank’s branches and sub-branches across the country. The agreement was signed on Tuesday by Mr. Shamsul Haque Sufyani, Managing Director (Current Charge) of Community Bank Bangladesh PLC and Mr. Md. Masud Parvez, Director, Financial Monitoring (Northern Region) of Bangladesh Rural Electrification Board, on behalf of their respective organisations, according to a press release. Under the agreement, customers of all Palli Bidyut Samities under BREB will be able to pay their electricity bills conveniently, securely, and efficiently through Community Bank’s nationwide network of branches and sub-branches. Among those present from Bangladesh Rural Electrification Board were Ms. Milia Sharmin, Member (Finance) and Joint Secretary; Mr. Md. Idris, Controller (Finance & Accounts); Mr. Sharmin Mahmud, Secretary of the Board; Mr. Md. Zia Uddin, Director (Finance); and Mr. Himel Pal, Director (Finance). Representing Community Bank Bangladesh PLC were Dr. Md. Ariful Islam, Head of Corporate Banking & Head of Business (Branch); Mr. Md. Tanjim Morshed Bhuiyan, Chief Information Technology Officer; Mr. Sujat Haque, Unit Head, Corporate Banking Division; Mr. Md. Shariful Islam Kadir, FCA, Chief Financial Officer; Mr. Mamun Ur Rahman, Head of ADC &Head of MD’s Coordination Team; Mr. Tohinul Islam and Mr. Nishit Kanti Sarkar from the Cash Management Team, along with other senior officials from both organisations.
